inlineSql: Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT AC_CITY FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_CITY ORDER BY AC_CITY
SELECT AC_STATE FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_STATE ORDER BY AC_STATE
SELECT AC_AREA FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_AREA ORDER BY AC_AREA
SELECT EMP_CODE,EMP_NAME FROM EMP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY EMP_CODE
Select * From BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
SELECT A.BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,A.CO_BOOK As BookL FROM BOOK_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME
SELECT A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE FROM AD_MEMB AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.MEMB_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.MEMB_CODE as MembNoL,A.MEMB_NAME As MembNameL,A.AC_MOBILE AS MobileL,A.SCHM_CODE AS SchemeL ,A.MEMB_AMT AS SchmAmtR,FORMAT(SUM(IIF(SIGN = '+',B.ADJ_AMT,- B.ADJ_AMT)),'0.00') AS MembBalR FROM AD_MEMB AS A LEFT JOIN AD_OS AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE AND A.MEMB_CODE = B.MEMB_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.SCHM_CODE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_NAME,A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_AMT,A.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_CODE
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
Select * From PRODUCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND PR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT A.PR_NAME As ProdNameL,A.PR_CODE As CodeL FROM PRODUCT_MAST AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.PR_CODE
Select * From LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select LC_CODE As CodeL,LC_NAME As NameL,LC_ADD1 As AddressL,LC_CITY As CityL FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE
Select * From GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT GR_NAME As GrNameL,GR_CODE as GrCodeL,GR_TYPE as TypeL,TRAD_TYPE As TradTypeL FROM GROUP_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY GR_NAME
SELECT A.CO_BOOK,A.BOOK_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.CO_BOOK
Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE As ItCodeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_CODE
